class.name: IdeamToolWorkspace
class.brief_description: Reusable Tier 2 orchestration workspace base class for Ideam studio tools.
class.description: Provides a standardized MemoryProfiler/GraphComposer-inspired shell: a top command bar with [ThemeSelector], Update Policy picker, Save / Save All buttons, and domain action slots; a left tabbed open-asset sidebar; a center Tier 1 control host resolved through the decoupled registry; and a right [RuntimeInspector] dock. Tier 2 workspaces never mutate domain data directly and can be embedded cleanly inside future Tier 3+ cross-plugin tools.

method.name: configure_theme_registry
method.description: Configures the ThemeRegistry resource path used by the command bar's ThemeSelector.

method.name: ensure_sidebar_tab
method.description: Creates a named open-asset sidebar tab if it does not already exist.

method.name: set_tool_context
method.description: Binds a shared [IdeamToolContext] so multiple Tier 2 workspaces can share themes, undo/redo, and dirty state.

method.name: open_asset
method.description: Opens [param asset] in its registered sidebar tab and mounts its Tier 1 control.

method.name: close_asset
method.description: Closes [param asset] and removes it from the open-asset sidebar.

method.name: close_all_assets
method.description: Closes all currently open assets in this workspace.

method.name: select_asset
method.description: Focuses an already-open [param asset] in the center host and right inspector.

method.name: save_asset
method.description: Saves [param asset] to disk via [ResourceSaver] and clears its dirty badge.

method.name: save_all_assets
method.description: Saves all open dirty assets and returns the number of assets saved.

members.member: Unique identifier used to look up registered Tier 1 control factories in the control registry.

signal.name: asset_opened
signal.description: Emitted when an asset is opened in the workspace.

signal.name: asset_closed
signal.description: Emitted when an asset is closed.

signal.name: asset_selected
signal.description: Emitted when the user switches the active asset.

signal.name: asset_saved
signal.description: Emitted after an asset is saved to disk.

signal.name: theme_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the workspace theme changes.
